title: Safeguarded automated batching & cache config rollout with canary gates
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a production-safe automated apply flow for batching/caching recommendations generated by the Optimize engine. This ticket scopes the server-side rollout controller changes, metric-based canary gates, and the operator playbook for approvals and automatic rollback. The goal is to let Optimize proposals be applied to serving configs at scale while ensuring no user-facing regressions (latency/correctness) and a clear recovery path.
acceptance_criteria: A backend rollout-controller API that understands staged percentages and per-stage metric checks is implemented and deployed to staging
Canary policy supports per-variant traffic split: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with configurable guards
Automated checks: cost-per-token, p50/p95 latency, error-rate, and 'eval-quality' score are evaluated for each stage and can trigger auto-hold or rollback
Console shows a rollout timeline and links to the active canary run and its metrics
A documented operator playbook (preflight checks, abort/rollback commands, postmortem checklist) exists in Confluence
End-to-end test (integration) that simulates a suggestion apply with a controlled degradation and validates automatic rollback
playbook: Preflight: verify staging rollout succeeds and load-profile mirrors production (see /confluence/optimize/prereqs)
Start: create rollout with descriptive tag and expected metrics thresholds
Stage 0 (smoke): 1% traffic for 10 minutes — require no regression in p95 and error_rate
Stage 1: 5% traffic for 20 minutes — require cost decrease >= 1% OR eval-quality >= baseline - 0.5% and latency regression <= 3%
Stage 2: 25% traffic for 30 minutes — additional checks for cache-hit-ratio and KV-store errors
Stage 3: 100% traffic finalization — monitor for 1 hour before marking done
Abort: operator can manually pause; auto-hold triggers if any stage check fails
Rollback: controller runs revert step to previous config and emits incident to #oncall-cost-ops channel
Postmortem: capture traces, failing prompts, and token cost delta; schedule RCA within 72 hours
rollout_plan: API: POST /api/v1/rollouts to create staged apply with config diff and thresholds
Controller: rollout-controller (k8s) reads plan, executes traffic splits via proxy layer and config-store swaps
Metrics: grafana panels and alerts enable automatic evaluation every minute
Fallback: ensure previous model config pinned in config-store for instant revert
Audit: write rollout events to audit-log and emit to customer-facing Console activity feed
